plugins.permissions.desc.ai_agent: Act as an AI assistant: give till data to the AI model you chose in its settings — only the kinds of data you tick. Never PINs, passwords, API keys or card data.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_send_catalog: Give the AI model your item data: items, prices, categories, modifiers and item photos.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_send_custome: Give the AI model your customers' personal data.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_send_sales: Give the AI model your sales data: receipts, payments, refunds, shifts and sales totals.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_send_staff: Give the AI model your staff data: staff names, roles and who did what in the audit trail.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_send_stock: Give the AI model your stock data: stock levels, movements and suppliers.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_send_till_he: Give the AI model your till's health data: devices, sync, errors and activity.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_tool_provide: Offer tools the AI assistant can use; it may receive the data you allowed the assistant to read.
Offer tools that change data; each change needs your confirmation.
plugins.permissions.desc.ai_tools_write: Ask to change data in this area. Every change is shown to you and only happens after you confirm it.
plugins.permissions.desc.blob_own: Store its own files privately (e.g. images or documents it generates).
plugins.permissions.desc.cloud_directive: Receive instructions sent to it from your Universal Till cloud account.
plugins.permissions.desc.db_own: Store its own data privately — never your sales or customer data.
plugins.permissions.desc.device_info: Read this till's device ID, local network addresses and time zone (e.g. for tax authority fraud-prevention headers).
plugins.permissions.desc.http_lan: Connect to devices on your shop's local network (e.g. a receipt printer or card reader).
plugins.permissions.desc.http_stream: Send and receive larger data over the internet in a continuous stream.
plugins.permissions.desc.net_validation: Download data such as certificate revocation lists and timestamps from this one internet address over unencrypted HTTP. Anyone on the network path can read or change this connection; the plugin is expected to check the data's signatures itself.
plugins.permissions.desc.schedule: Run on a repeating schedule in the background.
plugins.permissions.desc.secret_write: Store a credential it already has (e.g. a device password) securely.
plugins.permissions.desc.ui_page: Add its own page or screen to the till.
plugins.permissions.desc.ui_slot: Add content to a specific place in the till's screens.
plugins.permissions.desc.view: Read specific till reports you've approved (e.g. sales by day).
plugins.permissions.desc.view_shop: Read your shop's name, this till's name, its currency and default language. Never sales, staff or customers.
plugins.permissions.desc.view_users: Read your staff list — names and whether each person is active. Never PINs, usernames or roles.

plugins.settings.ai.hosted_provider_noti: Choosing a hosted provider (provider = claude or openai) sends what the AI features work on out of your premises to that provider's servers (Anthropic or OpenAI, both United States): for Identify by camera, the product photo plus your catalog's item names, SKUs and reference photos; for Ask your till, your questions together with the sales and stock figures used to answer them. With provider = openai_compatible, the same data (without reference photos) goes to whatever server the endpoint setting names — on your own hardware it stays with you, a public address sends it there. Self-hosted (Ollama, the default) keeps all of it on your own hardware. The key you enter is your own account with that provider — you pay them directly, and Universal Till holds no account there.
plugins.settings.ai.image_endpoint_inval: This isn't a valid web address, so the till ignores it and keeps using its built-in background removal. Start it with http:// or https://, for example http://192.168.1.20:7000.
plugins.settings.ai.image_model_unsuppor: This model isn't supported for background removal, so the till ignores it and keeps using its built-in background removal. Use birefnet-general-lite or u2netp.
